name: Camera Adaptive Subdivision
description: 根据活动相机的视角和深度调整网格细分，在靠近相机的区域生成更多细节。
notes: 节点使用场景的活动相机。使用时请填写模型的 UV 名称，并将分辨率设置为与渲染输出一致；“安全值”限制细分后的面数。
example: 在网格物体上添加几何节点修改器并选择该节点组，移动活动相机，观察网格细分随相机位置和视角的变化；调整“范围”和“细分等级”可改变细分的深度范围和密度。

inputs.name: 细分方法
inputs.description: 简单型 (Simple) keeps the original shape; Catmull-Clark smooths the mesh while subdividing.
inputs.de: 简单型 (Simple) keeps the original shape; Catmull-Clark smooths the mesh while subdividing.
inputs.dz: 简单型保持原有形状；Catmull-Clark 在细分时平滑网格。

inputs.name: uv
inputs.description: Name of the UV layer the model uses. It must be filled in.
inputs.de: Name of the UV layer the model uses. It must be filled in.
inputs.dz: 必须填写模型使用的 UV 图层名称。

inputs.name: 细分等级
inputs.description: Subdivision strength. Higher levels add more faces.
inputs.de: Subdivision strength. Higher levels add more faces.
inputs.dz: 控制细分强度。提高等级会增加网格数量。

inputs.name: 范围
inputs.description: Camera-depth range, in meters, over which the subdivision level falls off. Areas near the camera get the highest level, which decreases with depth. For example, with a range of 6 m and a level of 3, the level drops from 3 to 0 between 0 and 6 m of camera depth.
inputs.de: Camera-depth range, in meters, over which the subdivision level falls off. Areas near the camera get the highest level, which decreases with depth. For example, with a range of 6 m and a level of 3, the level drops from 3 to 0 between 0 and 6 m of camera depth.
inputs.dz: 设置细分等级随相机深度变化的范围，单位为米。靠近相机的区域细分等级较高，随着深度增加逐渐降低。例如，范围为 6 米、细分等级为 3 时，相机深度从 0 到 6 米，对应的细分等级从 3 逐渐降低到 0。

inputs.name: 安全值
inputs.description: Limits the face count after subdivision. Before each subdivision step the node predicts the resulting face count; if it would exceed this value, that step is skipped and the previous result is kept.
inputs.de: Limits the face count after subdivision. Before each subdivision step the node predicts the resulting face count; if it would exceed this value, that step is skipped and the previous result is kept.
inputs.dz: 限制细分后的面数。每次细分前，节点会预测这次细分产生的面数；如果预计超过安全值，就取消本次细分，保留之前的结果。

inputs.name: 分辨率
inputs.description: Render width and height. Must match the render output.
inputs.de: Render width and height. Must match the render output.
inputs.dz: 必须设置为与渲染输出一致的宽度和高度。

outputs.name: Geometry
outputs.dz: 经过自适应细分的网格。
